description: Presidential Secretariat - Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979
reasoning: The gazette content is an order by the President declaring a wide range of services (electricity, fuel, healthcare, transport, etc.) as "essential public services" under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. This constitutes the creation of a legal/regulatory framework and the exercise of statutory powers. While it is issued by the President, the core content is not about government structure, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio assignments. Instead, it is a legal instrument that establishes compliance requirements and regulatory conditions for specified services, fitting the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
